name: Threat Framework (shared)
description: Shared rarity/timing base every hidden-threat scenario includes: an existence lottery (a threat may simply not be in this game) and a year floor (no threat seeds, triggers or rises before this many years in), each overridable per threat. No flags of its own — nothing runs unless a threat scenario that includes this one also turns a threat on.

params.name: threatExistChancePct
params.label: Chance any given hidden threat exists in this game (%)

params.name: threatMinYear
params.label: Earliest year any hidden threat may seed, trigger or rise
